key_insight: HT-PAder is a parameter-free online convex optimization method that achieves optimal dynamic regret under heavy-tailed noise without needing prior knowledge of horizon, noise, or comparator path length.
engineering_relevance: This enables robust adaptive optimization for streaming and non-stationary systems where gradients are noisy, heavy-tailed, and the environment drifts over time.
method: Combines restarted AdaGrad experts over a geometric set of block lengths.
Uses AdaGrad-Hedge as a pathwise meta-algorithm to aggregate experts.
Requires no moment assumptions on meta-losses and no tuning of problem parameters.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports an expected universal dynamic regret bound of ~O(GD√(T(1+P_T/D)) + σDT^(1/p)(1+P_T/D)^((p-1)/p)) and states a matching lower bound for the path-length exponent.
watch_item: Performance guarantees are theoretical and rely on assumptions such as convexity, Lipschitz continuity, and a finite p-th noise moment, which may be challenging to verify in practice.
paper_title: Parameter-Free Dynamic Regret for Online Convex Optimization under Heavy-Tailed Noise
